name: 嗜波螺
evolution: 波波螺 → 消波螺 Lv.16 → 嗜波螺 Lv.32
description: 在海浪冲击下，演化出坚韧的矿物质石柱外壳，是一种非常稳定的消波结构，能把浪涌的力量层层化解。声音在石柱间隙中不断反射产生共鸣，能发出类似海浪的声音。
descriptionEn: Under the impact of waves, it evolved a tough mineral stone-pillar shell, a very stable wave-dissipating structure that layers and resolves the force of surging waves. Sound continuously reflects and resonates within the gaps of the stone pillars, producing sounds similar to ocean waves.
